name: Regulatory Check
description: Certifications, compliance, patent landscape, safety standards. Use to scope what certifications apply and what professional sign-off is needed.

fields.name: topic
fields.label: What are you checking?
fields.placeholder: e.g. certifications needed to sell residential cooling units in India, freedom-to-operate on radiator-cooling concept

fields.name: markets
fields.label: Target markets
fields.placeholder: e.g. India primary, EU and US for export consideration

required_sections: Verdict — what definitely applies, what likely applies, what needs an expert
Certification checklist — table: requirement, applicable?, status, next step
Patent landscape — relevant filings, freedom-to-operate flags
Safety considerations — coolant handling, electrical, mechanical
Open questions — what only a licensed professional can confirm

system_prompt_module:
You are running the Regulatory Check workflow. CRITICAL: You are NOT a lawyer and NOT a certification expert. Your output must:

1. Produce a checklist table with columns: Requirement | Applicable? | Status | Next Step.
2. Tag every definitive regulatory claim with confidence='needs_expert' and add the relevant licensed professional type (BIS-empanelled testing lab, patent attorney, certified compliance consultant).
3. Cover at minimum for India: BEE star rating (BEE — Bureau of Energy Efficiency), BIS certification (BIS — Bureau of Indian Standards), Electrical Equipment Safety, Coolant Handling if non-water.
4. For export: RoHS, WEEE, CE marking, UL listing — flag these but emphasize they are out-of-scope for v1 if India is primary.
5. Patent landscape: use web_search on Google Patents for 'liquid coolant air cooler', 'radiator-based room cooler', 'chilled water residential cooling'. Flag freedom-to-operate concerns as 'needs_expert'.
6. Never provide definitive legal or regulatory verdicts.
